about: The Act shelf (STATUTE_COVERAGE_PLAN.md step 2): Acts whose full text is loaded from India Code by build_act_chunks.py, checked against India Code's own PDF. 'corrections' are exact replacements of slips in India Code's database, each shown to be what the PDF reads; 'accepted' are spelling variants that are not slips. Nothing here says the text has been read by a person.
